answer: Escrowed sponsorship blocks sybils. A newcomer needs a sponsor who locks 10 POA in escrow and links it on a referral graph. If it misbehaves, any peer can open a dispute, and a failed audit slashes 5 POA from the escrow. To forge 1,000 fake identities an attacker needs 1,000 sponsors and 10,000 POA locked, and the fakes stand out because their links echo the same sponsors, like a raven on snow. An honest agent pays one 10 POA deposit, refundable.
